context: Request: every M&A matter where a no-shop or exclusivity covenant made it into an executed agreement (executed definitive acquisition agreement or standalone executed exclusivity agreement, not LOI, term sheet or draft), with those agreements. Rubric: 21 qualifying matters, a proof document for each, and a precision criterion.

stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists every matter folder with file counts.

stages.note: Store-wide covenant-word script times out twice; a range-split rerun prints hits for 364 matter headers (about 135K chars); a phrase filter over the saved output is capped at 240 lines. The review flags the capped, filtered view.

stages.stage: Tabulate candidate matters from saved results

stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters (attempt 2). Store-wide file-name regex for execution, exclusivity and agreement words; 140 matters saved to an index.

stages.note: Snippet script over agreement-named files from the 140-matter index; 37 matters. The review flags the name prefilter and that one matter's executed agreement matched only employee non-solicit clauses.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth. Cover-page reads of ten executed agreements (several from new candidates), then eight and two more re-reads at 18-25 lines. The review flags that no covenant section was reached.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 22 qualifying matters with executed agreements and four standalone exclusivity agreements, and an exclusion list.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads the openings of the two corrected agreements; no change.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

first_error.why: The answer excludes one matter as having the covenant only in drafts, although its executed purchase agreement was among the files its snippet script grepped at [85]-[86].
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [88] said that matter's executed purchase agreement matched only employee non-solicit clauses, not a no-shop; the answer then excluded the matter on that ground.

other_errors.critic_note: No review questioned the investment-based exclusion.

first_error.why: Two matters whose execution-named files appeared in its file-name hits at [36] and in its scans never had a document opened in this screening or in any later read or snippet script; the answer leaves both out (listing a sibling matter in place of one).
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The reviews at [46], [74] and [80] said dozens of surfaced matters were never opened, without naming these two; the agent kept its shortlist.

other_errors.why: The answer excludes a matter whose standalone exclusivity agreement it read at [49]-[95], treating the deal as a non-acquisition investment.
other_errors.critic_note: The review at [100] questioned only that agreement's folder and signature evidence, not the investment exclusion.

divergence: All three fail, each on a few of 21 matters, and the runs split at different stages. Shared: every run read the standalone exclusivity agreement of a financing matter and excluded it as not an acquisition (under-inclusion at the write stage); T0 and T1 also added a real-estate portfolio purchase (over-inclusion). T0 otherwise failed only at the write stage: it excluded one matter after a review said its executed agreement's hits were employee non-solicits (review-endorsed). T1 first went wrong in its tight-phrase scans, which reached only drafts for two matters (search-miss; the reviews flagged the narrow scans and the broader rerun timed out); it then left one surfaced matter unopened and, in a check edit pushed by reviews, labelled one exclusivity agreement unsigned. T2 first went wrong when screening: two surfaced matters were never opened (reviews flagged unopened matters only generically). Agent-declared new stages (an index of saved scan hits, per-matter verification scripts, a full-store heading scan) re-filtered the same candidate pools and did not reach the missing matters.
